entities.name: Spare half octet
entities.description: Used in EMM and ESM messages when an odd number of half octet type 1 information elements are present. Contains spare bits set to zero and is typically placed in bits 5 to 8 of the octet.

entities.name: EMM messages
entities.description: Evolved Mobility Management messages used in LTE networks for mobility management procedures.

entities.name: ESM messages
entities.description: EPS Session Management messages used in LTE networks for session management procedures.

entities.name: Half octet type 1 information elements
entities.description: Information elements that occupy half octets in message formats.

relations.description: EMM messages may contain the spare half octet IE when an odd number of half octet type 1 IEs are used.
ESM messages may contain the spare half octet IE when an odd number of half octet type 1 IEs are used.
The spare half octet is used when there is an odd number of half octet type 1 information elements in a message.
